In the community bulletin, it is important to highlight the mending of fishing nets, as they are essential for the livelihood of many. Local fishermen regularly gather to repair and reinforce their nets, ensuring they remain strong and effective for the upcoming fishing season. The process involves careful work, with each part of the net being inspected and stitched together. 

A key part of this process is the use of a trestle, which helps keep the net organized and stable during repairs. The trestle also plays a vital role in securing the net to the boat, ensuring that the work is done safely and efficiently. The community is encouraged to support these efforts, as the mending of fishing nets is a shared responsibility.
